summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests AZD3470, a PRMT5 inhibitor, alone or with other anticancer drugs, in people with blood cancers such as Hodgkin lymphoma and peripheral T-cell lymphoma. AZD3470 is taken by mouth, and the record does not state how long or how often it is given. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the body processes the drug, its effects on the body, and early signs of benefit.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa AZD3470, un inhibidor de PRMT5, solo o con otros medicamentos contra el cáncer, en personas con cánceres de la sangre como el linfoma de Hodgkin y el linfoma periférico de células T. AZD3470 se toma por vía oral, y el registro no indica cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia se administra. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo el cuerpo procesa el medicamento, sus efectos en el organismo y las primeras señales de beneficio.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with relapsed or refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma after at least two prior lines, including BV and anti-PD1 therapy.
Adults 50 or older with stage III or IV classical Hodgkin lymphoma that reached at least a partial response to first-line therapy.
Adults 18 or older with relapsed or refractory PTCL-NOS, ALCL, or AITL after at least one prior line of therapy.
Adults 18 or older with relapsed or refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma after at least one prior line, for the pembrolizumab combination module.
Participants must provide baseline tumour tissue and have at least one measurable or FDG-avid lymphoma lesion.
not_for: Active lymphoma in the brain, spinal cord, or leptomeninges.
Active hepatitis B or C, or known HIV positive.
Heart failure grade II to IV, cardiomyopathy, or resting QTcF above 470 msec.
Prior PRMT5 or MAT2A inhibitor, or anti-lymphoma therapy within 21 days.
